statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and dizziness
There is concern for sick sinus syndrome in the context of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has a recent history of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
Continuous ambulatory monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias
The service is intended to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
The diagnosis codes are I49.5, G45.9, and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
